The WESTLINE difference

Stop guessing. Start surfing the right board.

Buying a surfboard online means wading through volume, rocker, fin setups, and tail shapes most beginners have never heard of. The Finder turns that into five plain-language questions — then explains the answer the way a shaper would, in person.

  1. 01

    Your level

    Beginner, intermediate, or advanced — and how long you've been surfing.

  2. 02

    Your build & habits

    Height, weight, and how many sessions you get in a week.

  3. 03

    Your waves

    Beach break, point break, or wherever you can actually get to.

  4. 04

    Your goals

    Catching more waves, progressing toward a shortboard, or just cruising.
